detail: Initial PowerShell identity probe failed on an empty pipeline element; no artifact mutation occurred.
First make.py launch resolved WORKSPACE one parent too shallow and failed before writing output; corrected prospectively in make.py.

Second make.py launch rejected a mistyped obsolete-Post44 expected hash; independent line-span replay established the exact 96,875-byte hash 34428DAF02BDDDB88B882F4A2918E2BA302F29BF41FF0DFF51064EF7BA183253 before generation.
First cumulative build stopped at undefined Pandoc control \tightlist; wrapper-only compatibility definition added.
Second cumulative build stopped at locally out-of-scope source-footnote macro \srcfn; wrapper reintroduced the established cumulative macro definition.
Third cumulative build stopped at undefined \mathscr; wrapper supplied a semantic \mathcal fallback without changing target prose or formulas.
First text-extraction probe used a Poppler directory lacking pdftotext.exe; successful retry used the installed MiKTeX pdftotext executable.
Initial Post44 QA record was written successfully before a Windows stdout encoding error; qa.py output was made ASCII-safe and the valid record retained.
Pillow emitted a non-substantive getdata deprecation warning after the comparison record had passed and been written; comparison data are unaffected.

The material German canon dispatch and subsequent readback calls did not return before bounded termination; the three schema-valid packets remain durable under ../paper44/de and German was not mutated.
